verdict.rationale: The evidence shows serverless SQL (D1, created via `wrangler d1 create`) and 'global database acceleration' for querying external databases, but nothing documents a fully-managed Postgres offering. There is also no evidence of point-in-time recovery, replicas, or high availability. A community member even lists a Postgres service on Workers as an unmet wish, and connecting to an external database via Bindings is an adjacent building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision a fully-managed Postgres database with point-in-time recovery, replicas, and high availability
